title.value: An Act relating to toxic chemicals; prohibiting, with certain exceptions, the discharge, use or release of certain Class B firefighting foams; requiring, with certain exceptions, certain entities who discharge, use or release certain Class B firefighting foam to notify the Division of Environmental Protection of the State Department of Conservation and Natural Resources; requiring the Division to establish a working group to study issues relating to certain substances; prohibiting, with certain exceptions, the manufacture, sale or distribution of certain products containing certain chemicals; providing penalties; and providing other matters properly relating thereto.
title.provenance: AN ACT relating to toxic chemicals; prohibiting, with certain exceptions, the discharge, use or release of certain Class B firefighting foams; requiring, with certain exceptions, certain entities who discharge, use or release certain Class B firefighting foam to notify the Division of Environmental Protection of the State Department of Conservation and Natural Resources; requiring the Division to establish a working group to study issues relating to certain substances; prohibiting, with certain exceptions, the manufacture, sale or distribution of certain products containing certain chemicals; providing penalties; and providing other matters properly relating thereto.

location.provenance: The People Of The State Of Nevada, REPRESENTED IN SENATE AND ASSEMBLY, DO ENACT AS FOLLOWS:

status.provenance: Section 27.1 states 'This section becomes effective upon passage and approval'. Section 27.2 states 'Sections 6 to 14.5, inclusive, of this act become effective: ... for all other purposes.' on January 1, 2022.

pfas_definition.provenance: Sec. 9. 'Perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances' means a class of fluorinated organic chemicals that contain at least one fully fluorinated carbon atom.

type.provenance: Sections 12 and 13 prohibit and restrict the discharge, use, or release of Class B firefighting foams containing intentionally added perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances.

date.provenance: Sections 6 to 14.5, inclusive, of this act become effective on January 1, 2022, for all other purposes.

who.provenance: Sections 12 and 13 apply to 'a person, political subdivision, local government or state or local agency'.

action.provenance: Sections 12 and 13 prohibit discharging, using, or releasing Class B firefighting foams containing intentionally added perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances.

value: Class B firefighting foam that contains intentionally added perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances

preempted by or conflict with federal law, including, without limitation, any provision of federal law requiring the use of Class B firefighting foam that contains intentionally added perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances pursuant to 14 C.F.R. Part 139 or for military purposes
exceptions.provenance: Sec. 10 provides an exception to the extent that those provisions are preempted by or conflict with federal law.

currently_unavoidable.provenance: The regulation does not mention 'currently unavoidable use'.

intentionally_added.provenance: Sec. 8.5 defines 'Class B firefighting foam that contains intentionally added perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances'.

type.provenance: Sections 24 and 25 prohibit the manufacture, sale, distribution, and replacement of certain products containing flame-retardant organohalogenated chemicals.

date.provenance: Sections 1 to 5, inclusive, and 15 to 26, inclusive, of this act become effective on July 1, 2022, for all other purposes.

who.provenance: Sections 24 and 25 apply to 'a manufacturer' and 'a retailer'.

action.provenance: Sections 24 and 25 prohibit manufacturing, selling, offering for sale, distributing for sale, or distributing for use of specified products.

value: thread or fiber for stitching mattress components
components of an adult mattress other than foam

currently_unavoidable.provenance: The regulation does not mention 'currently unavoidable use'.

intentionally_added.provenance: Sections 24 and 25 focus on amounts greater than 1,000 parts per million, not intentional addition.
